==Background==
"'''Raspberry*Monster'''" is an original song by HoneyWorks. The lyrics are somewhat vague, but it could be about a girl who has social problems and lives in a fantasy world where she is a superhero.

This song has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame|Hall of Legend]]'' and exceeded over 2 million YouTube views. It is featured in the albums ''[[六弦アストロジー (Rokugen Astrology)|Rokugen Astrology]]'' and ''[[ずっと前から好きでした。 (Zutto Mae Kara Suki Deshita.)|Zutto Mae Kara Suki Deshita.]]''. It's also featured in the game [[Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- X]], being the song featured in the game's first trailer.
